stars as a complement to regular dental flossing   stars as a replacement to regular dental flossing  when i first got this i thought it was the greatest thing ever  mouth felt refreshing and it removed things that was left behind after regular dental flossing  i liked it so much that i used it exclusively for  months without regular dental flossing  when i went back to regular dental flossing it proved to be a bit more challenging  floss string did not glide as easily  thats when i realized that the two products remove different things  i think the water flosser is better at removing food particles that has recently been eaten while the string flosser is better at removing food particles that has been sitting in your mouth for the entire day  sure the water flosser can do the same but youd have to keep the water flosser in the same spot for maybe  seconds to accomplish this  so in conclusion for the best result use it along with regular dental flossing rather than as a replacement  as for this unit i have a couple of gripes  the blue pause button on the handle gets stuck after a few months of use  youd press and hold it to pause the water flow but when you release the button it remains depressed  i no longer use the pause button on the handle i just use the onoff button  as for the lid that stores the tips you can have mold build up from the moisture over time  i now just keep the lid open overnight to let it air dry  when the setting is on  the water will drain quickly and youd have to refill a second time to get a complete cleaning  overall im very happy and would recommend this product

step process each night for three nights then only use a wet cloth to wash your face in the morning  because this product makes great promises in a very short period of time and for  for a small amount of product lets be honest and because i read reviews before i make purchases and because i was able to purchase this product at a discount in exchange for evaluation and my honest review i have swallowed my pride uhm ego and am not only going to share the process for this product but also several of my naked face photos  before during and after this way you my fellow amazon buyer may not only read my opinion but also decide for yourself how much difference this product made in at least this instance for me  basics i am a woman former marine and ugh a smoker i will be turning  in june  and although i have so far not found any actual wrinkles other than a couple of minor horizontal lines on my forehead thanks dad  grandma for the genetics i did have fairly prominent acne from about  until after   even a couple now leaving scars mostly on my cheeks and chin i also was a serious sun worshipper getting as brown as i possibly could including tanning beds outdoor activities the marine corps and beachpool lounging anyone my age group remember baby oil and iodine the worst thing you can do for your skin yep that was me it honestly is a miracle i dont look like a raisin i do have discoloration  brown patches all over my face i stopped actively tanning just after my th birthday and now always wear sunscreen at least in my facial moisturizer i do have a pretty good routine now because i want to try to preserve what i have and fight mother nature and gravity as much as possible but my face needs some work all photos were taken at approx the same time in the same place with camera at approx the same distance from my face too close and in the same lighting no filters or photoshop used before picture the before photo hopefully these will show up in the proper order but in it i am wearing a grey tshirt with black squares and a pony tail shows the brown spots scarring and general lack of glow this was the night i began the process  the process three stepsthree days step cloth i did this for two reason  because i didnt trust that the small amount of cleanser would actually remove makeup and clean enough and  because i wanted naked skin to evaluate the cleanser itself  i need not have worried the cleanser cleans the skin and prepares it for the peel product at step two the cleanser was very pleasant clean smelling and although it foamed very little see photo of this step it amazingly did a great job of further cleansing the skin and removing every trace of makeup i know this because i used a white wash cloth to rinse my face  no i didnt photograph the dirty cloth my skin felt quite clean but not squeakystripped which is good imo step two nonirritating pro peel  this is a clear gel see pic which had a slight astringent smell to it this is applied to the now clean and towel dries skin using fingertips the directions say to keep it on for  minutes or  for sensitive skin rinse them pat dry i felt no tingling or burning at all just the alcohol smell which is no big deal this product does not dry like a mask and it doesnt turn white like some chemical peels are supposed to do in fact on the second night i got distracted and left this on for over  minutes moisturizer oh my goodness i absolutely love love love this moisturizer  i am going to try finding this alone for use as a night cream as you can see from the photos of the dots of moisturizer on my face there was not a lot of the cream in the packet  i thought it would not be enough i always treat my neck all around and my chest area with the same process as my face but  again  i was wrong to be worried this moisturizer feels so very good i honestly wanted to use it all over when i find the moisturizer alone i will edit this review and add the name of the product  this cream was the perfect way to end the process  all three steps took less than  minutes per night  the after photo was taken this morning because i wanted to allow the third nights process to fully work so the lighting is a bit different if anything the daylight is harsher than the night photos and i took this picture even closer so i could really see  results it is usually difficult to be objective about your own appearance at least it is for me i look at this face each day and see all my faults however i honestly can say that i have noticed smaller pore appearance and brighter smoother skin putting on my first some background im a long time electric user ive never had a fancy electric razor i used an inexpensive corded remington for years before i got tired of the cord and switched to a basic cordless norelco model x to be exact my norelco has worked just fine for many years ive replaced the blades on my x before and now i realized it wasnt shaving as close and decided that rather than replace the blades maybe it was time to check out one of the many newer norelcos that have come on the market since i bought mine  i chose the speedxl the concept of the triple heads with multiple size screen slots sounded like it might offer an even better shave than my trusty x well after a month of using my speedxl i have discovered that for me it shaved no better than my x with old blades in fact i decided to go ahead and replace the blades on my x and well i hate to say it but for my face my old x with the new blades actually does a better job i even went so far as to shave half of my face with one and the other half with the other on two different occasions then asked my wife which side felt smoother without telling her of my test one time she couldnt tell the difference that was before i replaced the blades on the x the other time she picked the side i shaved with my old norelco  so whats the moral and what should you do well if like me you had an old norelco that uses the hq  blades you might want to consider just getting new blades rather that purchasing the speedxl however if you dont already have an hq  based razor or yours is dead aka battery no longer charges then this is a fine albeit not fantastic electric razor that said id be tempted to buy a less expensive norelco that uses the hq  blades or consider a completely different model  of course all this ignores some of the extra features of the speedxl that may benefit you for instance the triple bladesscreen design might work better on your stubble or maybe the ease of cleaning the speedxl appeals to you if you value some of those other features then this may very well be a star razor for you  thats my story hope it helps

so what is this pitera stuff that skii markets as its unique active ingredient pitera is promoted as the secret key to this cosmetic thus the sk in the product name it is a byproduct of the yeast fermentation process of a specific strand of yeast used in japanese sake production yeast products are common in cosmetics but most are developed from beer pitera was initially marketed in the form of this clear watery extraordinarily expensive essence and benefit claims over time have included increasing the skins metabolism and regeneration rate helping the skin retain moisture smoothing skin texture minimizing dark spots and helping reduce acne the question is does it work and is it any better than other cosmetics    why are so many people buying skii products it may be because of celebrity endorsements or the mistaken idea that if it costs more it must be better it may also be because of the sweet and hopeful story behind the product who could fail to be charmed by a story of elderly sake factory workers whose faces were wrinkled but hands remained youthful the company website has a lovely childrens fairytale style commercial with this story at httpwwwskiicomaboutusmiraclehtmlajourneyback  pitera is presented as the result of an attempt to replicate the material the workers hands were in contact with all day long purchasers seem to ignore the fact that in cosmetic form the users contact with this product is brief and minisculedoes not begin to approach the level of allday handson contact with fermented yeast the sake workers would have experienced is it possible that the demographic this product is marketed to simply has no idea what hard handson physical work is like so they cant understand the difference between their small daub or splash of essence and a workers grueling hours of work day after day year after year with hands repeatedly reaching into vats of sticky fermented yeastcovered with a thick coating of it for hours through a work day   product facts significantly this is the largest selling prestige cosmetic in asia even inspiring a huge problem with counterfeit products sold in china which happened to be contaminated with dangerous levels of heavy metals skii has now been purchased by american giant proctor and gamble and is one of a small group of p  g products that has achieved more than a billion dollars in annual sales this is surely due to the extraordinary prices of skii products in addition to sales volume with even the basic  oz essence waters selling for  on the skii website and this  fl oz bottle selling here for   clearly the charm of the pitera story has led many many people to drink the koolaid or more kindly put to have hope and place their faith in a very clever marketing campaign and the idea of a natural fountain of youth although many skii products are loaded down with chemical additives of all sorts the company website includes some research links and reviews but after reading it and many other online resources related to the pitera ingredients and skii products i am not convinced that these products are good for all skin types or that they work as claimed in the tiny doses these products deliver we are not talking about a product priced at a level which would allow purchasers to soak hands or face in it bathe in it etc we are talking about the impact of just a few drops on the skin if this was an inexpensive brand i would say why not try this essence product which contains  pitera and experiment for yourself for  months or a year which would require multiple bottles however given the fact that using even  skii products could cost as much as a home mortgage experimenting makes no sense except for those for whom money is no object    does it work i dont think it is clear whether or not this product is working or might work over the very long term  to apply it users pour a small amount of what is essentially water into a cupped hand spread it along the hands and then press hands against the face  is it absorbing into the skin or simply drying on the surface  im not sure how anyone could answer that question with confidence  there is no clear explanation of the science behind this product how does it change the skin ph etc and why is that change a good thing  given the companys simple backstory of the sake factory workers hands being covered in a thick coating of pitera all day for years on end it is reasonable to assume that improvements gained with a few drops of this watery product providing such a tiny dose of pitera might take a long time involving enormous expense or might be quite subtle   messing with your microbiome it seems to me that p  g is making a claim that this product has a medical impact upon the bodyskin condition yet there is no real data or scientific rationale to support that claim  we are learning more and more about the human microbiome and ways that fungi viruses and bacteria support our health and negatively impact it  the balance of microbes in and on our bodies is important  it is not clear that adding this sake yeast culture or the beerrelated yeasts in other productsto ones face is a good thing or a bad thing or if it has a neutral impact  i would like to see a bit of peerreviewed science indicating that this is a healthy and safe product for all people  is that too much to ask  tiny companysponsored and nonpeer reviewed studies dont count   a final thought this product was offered to me as a free sample for review and it seemed kind of fun to try something which was far out of the range i am willing to spend on my appearance i would be seeing how the  live   but after some thought especially about the crazy price tag for a bottle of waterlike fluid it saddens me that women and sometimes men are so tyrannized by societal pressure to look younger so obsessed with outward appearances and so influenced by marketing ploys that they would spend so much money on a luxury cosmetic  living a healthy lifestyle is a better bet than this skii product real science has demonstrated over and over again that good nutrition good sleep no smoking and exercise positively impact the health and appearance of your skin as well as the rest of you   what if everyone who has been buying this stuff decided to save their money for something that matters the kids college fund a safer car for the family your retirement fund a visit to see your mom helping a neighbor who is out of work making a donation to the local homeless shelter or food pantry paying school tuition for a year for girls in afghanistan or cambodia or kenya supporting an animal shelter or wildlife sanctuary or your local symphony paying off student loans or mortgage faster anything that actually matters to you instead of something that you are buying because society tells you growing older makes you less attractive or less worthwhile  i think we all know deep down that the fountain of youth isnt found in a bottle we wish it was but it just isnt  your best chance of finding it is playing with a child without looking at your watch being kind to others learning something new taking a hike in the woods or walking along an ocean or stream living a peaceful life without sweating the small stuff listening to your cat purr or letting your dog sleep on the bed  anyone in your life who might love you or value you less because of wrinkles is someone you need to get rid of right now and if that person is you maybe start today being more gentle and loving with that person in the mirror  thats my two cents worth

time trimming it with his braun shavertrimmer he has a partial beard because he only grows it along his jaw line from his sideburns and down along his jawline on his chin and just underneath his jaw between the two of us i was sure we would give this remington beard trimmer a proper workout  this remington ms beard trimmer has a nice ergonomic shape and fit well in our hands its about  long and  wide on each side the length may seem long to some but we really didnt think so especially since my sons braun is about the same length of this trimmer the remington trimmer weighs in at about  ounces which is heavy enough to remind us that we have an electric tool in our hands and yet light enough to maneuver around a mans face and still stable enough to detail a beard with relative ease the trimmers housing is made of mostly polycarbonate pc which is a combination of thermoplastic polymers and carbonate for strength and durability  the trimmer comes with a number of accessories  three removable cutting blades  beard blade stubble blade and a goateedetail blade  an adjustable comb attachment  a battery charger  a cleaning brush  a small tube of lubricating oil it is powered by two nonreplaceable lithium ion phosphate batteries once the batteries are fully charged which can take several hours the remington trimmer can power at least  hours of cordless grooming we kept track and found we were able to use the trimmer between us for more than  hours the trimmer i received was already fully charged all we had to do was read the instructions and lubricate the blades  there is a scrolling wheel zoom wheel on the back side of the trimmer that allowed us to dial in the beard style we wanted the  settings offered us a choice of the stubble look and a short medium or long look when used with the adjustable comb attachment the beard lengths ranged from a minimum length of mm almost  to a maximum length of mm almost   i never enjoyed cleaning an electric razor primarily because i could never get the blades and blaze compartment completely clean so you can imagine my pleasant surprise when i found out how relatively easy this trimmer is to clean just detach the comb push the quick release button on the back of the trimmer near the head and carefully pull out the blade the titaniumcoated blades can be washed in warm water brushed with the cleaning brush and relubricated for future use removing and installing the comb and blades are not what i would describe as simple care must be taken to make sure they are attached correctly that took following the instructions in the users guide and some practice any powered device that is going to be used on your face needs to be assembled correctly and with care  so how did the trimmer work wow this is an easy to maneuver precision tool trimming under my nose and upper cheek was a breeze as well as my neck and my son really like how easy it was to cut a straight line along his jaw beard the overall comfort while trimming was most impressive too  ive saved what seems to be the most controversial feature of this remington trimmer to the last when i opened the commercial box i was taken by surprise for a moment or two this remington mb virtually invincible beard trimmer kit was encased in what you might expect a power drill or saber saw or some other small power tool would be stored in you know something tim the toolman taylor would be proud to carry around but a beard trimmer the case has a popopen lock and inside was a cardboard carton which contained the trimmer and all of its accessories the rub seems to be whether to continue to store the trimmer in the carton inside the case or toss the carton and let the trimmer and accessories bang around inside the case either way some reviewers were disappointed with the storage case some even thought it was silly  though i think remington was trying to play off of their virtually indestructible claim i didnt find the case all that bothersome i do agree that there could have been something better than a cardboard carton on the inside to prevent the trimmer and components from moving around so i got a piece of packing foam from downstairs and cut a piece to fit the top of the case and another piece to fit the bottom of the case and secured them in place with a hot glue gun voila now i have a useful case for my remington mb virtually indestructible beard trimmer kit  my son and i agreed that this remington trimmer gets two thumbs up

that ive used including my fiveyearold norelco which still shaves rings around this one  its shaving heads are very compact and pivot nicely so you can easily reach all contours of your face and hardtoreach areas eg under your nose  however the blades themselves dont do provide a close shave at all  i have a beard thats only moderately thickstiff and the x left me feeling like i would have a fiveoclock shadow in minutes  used wet in the shower its performance is much better  this is also when the cool skin moisturizer really shines  in fact its downright necessary to get the heads to glide over your face when used wet  it has a pleasant scent and does leave the skin on your face feeling refreshed afterward even if its also apparent that the cool is just from some alcohol in the formula  it certainly wont be the quickest shave that youve ever had but if you take your time you can get results that rival even a blade  use  maintenance  the x comes with a cradle for storing it upright and also for charging it  unfortunately once the razor becomes fully charged you cant leave it in the cradle without unplugging it  doing so can damage battery life  plus the plug for the cradle is gigantic and ugly so you wont want to leave the cradle on display anyway  i would have preferred a simple directcord charge design instead  the nivea conditioner that is used with the shaver is expensive in the long run  about  for a can that will last about a month dont believe what the box says  its only a months worth  suddenly that close wet shave is looking pretty pricey in terms of time and money compared to simply going back to shaving with a blade  also the pump system that feeds the conditioner into the razor is proprietary ie you cant just fill it with any skin conditioner because only the nivea cool skin fits the razors plug  so youre out of luck if you dont like the scent or feel of the nivea product  also the razor would lose just about all usefulness ifwhen they stop making those cans  there is no readout to display the remaining battery life  instead the power light will begin to flash when the battery is getting low  given the cost of this razor this seems like a cut corner  i dont like the idea of guessing how much juice i have left  the razor needs to be cleaned after each shave  compared to most closedhead designs this makes for even more time that the razor requires with each use  you also need to regularly check that the tubes which deliver the moisturizer havent become clogged  it does have a travel lock feature which will prevent the razor from accidentally turning on while you have it packed away  coupled with its compact size i think that the weekend getaway not for business may be the ideal application of this razor  conclusion  the x moisturizing shave system promises too much  ultimately it works best when shaving wet using a lot of the moisturizer and taking a lot of time to do so  this coupled with its lightweight compact design good battery life and travel lock make it ideal for weekend getaways  but given its cost  both immediate and in the long run  this just isnt enough return on your investment  pros  close comfortable shave when used wet  compact and lightweight  travel lock prevents accidents while razor is packed  good battery life  cons  unimpressive shave results when used dry  expensive costtooperate due to very necessary moisturizer  demanding upkeepmaintenance requirements  lack of battery gauge

i have always been a huge fan of braun products  the build quality and design always amazes me  i have owned several braun rechargeable shavers over the years not because they kept wearing out but because i like to experience the new technology braun puts into their latest products  now im not a very hairy man but i do require a beard and mustache trimmer a noseear hair trimmer and even a mini shaver for detailing  much to my disappointment braun does not make any of these trimmershavers  so even though i am a serious braun fan i always find myself having to purchase less quality products from other manufacturers  so when braun introduced the new bodycruzer groomer i was extremely intrigued  i wasnt too sure about the attached gillette fusion shaver as it looked rather dangerous to have perched atop a trimmer  well when i was offered the opportunity to test this new device i eagerly accepted  the product is packaged well and comes with everything you could need  the box includes the braun bodycruzer groomer with attached gillette fusion razor a weighted base charger stand  different attachment combs cleaning brush hanging holder for the bodycruzer travel pouch owners guide and warrantyregistration paperwork  there is also a replacement gillette fusion razor head included in the package  a concerning fact about this packaging is that the multiblade fusion razor head does not come with a cover so you want to be very careful removing the device from the packaging as one could easily cut themselves  the braun bodycruzer feels very solid well balance and feels good in your hand  the fusion razor sliding adjustment is well designed and easy to operate  charging is performed via an inductive type method through the base of the groomer handle itself with no exposed contacts  this great design virtually eliminates the possibility of electric shock  once charged for a few hours the bodycruzer comes to life with plenty of power to cut most body hair  it is not a beard trimmer although it can certainly be used for light beard and mustache trimming  however with that fusion razor head looming above the power trimmer it requires the user to practice extreme caution when using the trimmer anywhere on your face  it would be extremely easy to nick your ear or nose with the razor head  this is a wet and dry body grooming trimmershaver so you can use it with or without shaving cream and can use it in the shower andor rinse it clean with water  the attachment combs are convenient but are a little cumbersome to remove  it was very hard for me to feel confident doing anything with the end of the trimmer due to that multiblade razor sitting there so close to the trimmer head  i really feel that the razor adds a definite level of danger given the fact that the blades are always exposed  the operators manual states that the bodycruzer is not intended for removing facial hair or scalp hair  the manual also states that the trimming combs should be used on dry hair only and that shaving foam cream or gel should not be used when trimming with the comb attachments  it also advises using the sensitive comb attachment when trimming on skin in sensitive areas such as in the genital area  seriously the genital area  ok i guess some guys might like keeping that areaum well groomed  the manual advises using the trimming and shaving combination on large areas like the chest and back  i did not test this because i do not have back hair and i have no desire to shave my chest  braun also recommends applying a drop of machine oil onto the trimmer head on a weekly basis if the trimmer is cleaned under water  oddly enough my bodycruzer did not come with any machine oil so i guess they figure i would enjoy running out and buying it myself before using their trimmer  well they figured wrong  overall i find this device is geared toward extremely hairy men or men that want a smooth hairless chest andor genital area  i honestly assumed that the bodycruzer was meant for facial trimming and shaving in addition to grooming other areas of the body  since the device is not intended for the facial area i just dont have much use for the product  im also a bit scared of the razor head as there is no cover for the razor blades  now im not saying that this device is not good  it seems very well built as all braun products usually are and im sure some men will find it very handy for trimming and shaving hair in areas that i just dont have a need or desire  i do however feel that braun should have paid far more attention to safety regarding the extremely sharp fusion razor head  the way it is designed it would be very easy for someone to cut themselves on the razor blades  a simple cover would prevent accidental cuts and could also provide protection to the delicate blades themselves  then again im not an engineer so maybe they know something that i dont  but for me the braun bodycruzer will likely remain in a bathroom drawer most of the time  i have removed the razor head for the safety of myself and my family but will keep the bodycruzer handy in case i suddenly sprout back hair or decide to shave all of my body hair so i can join the olympic swim team  its a quality braun product that is clearly not designed or meant for every man

this review will cover the following a few notes on using the item how hot is it with a cooking time example and its suitability as a camp stove the item i received is a fire wheel wick kerosene stove model   first of all it is very important that the wicks be even if you have used a kerosene lamp before you know that a small spike in the wick can cause a huge spike in the flame limiting how high you can turn it up as the heat from this thing is marginal its important to get all you can after you have lit the stove but before you have put it together it is possible to pick up the wick holder and lower the offensively high wicks  the instructions tell you that to turn off the stove turn the wicks all the way down and let it go out by itself without blowing it out you will only need to wait about a minute for this to happen this will reduce smoke and odor and probably give you longer wick life  the usual instructions for these kind of things tell you to light it for the first time outside to burn off any oil or chemicals left from the factory i would suggest lighting it after dark so you can see what the flame is doing obviously you want a blue flame turn it down to get rid of the yellow  you could probably in an emergency use the stove as an wick kerosene candle  the stove came with a small fuel funnel and for some strange reason  extra wicks i guess if i buy a  pack of wicks i will then have enough for two changes  how hot is it   i have an electric stove with buttons labeled high   lo and warm it appears to be a little hotter than  on the big burner i have a pressure cooker thats slightly larger than a gallon that i cooked a pot of beans in though mine is an old gasketless clamp down type that doesnt release steam while its up to pressure so it might be more efficient than yours with three quarts of water with the beans it took about half an hour before i saw steam coming out another  minutes before the steam was substantial enough to start hissing at which point i closed the steam valve and another  minutes to get it up to  lbs  would it make a good backpacking or camp stove   on the plus side the dry weight of the stove without accessories is  oz and it is currently the lowest priced liquid fuel stove out there except for alcohol burners however its rather bulky x inches according to the instruction pamphlet and it is made of rather thin metal especially the catalytic converter which consists of two perforated metal sleeves that sit on either side of the wicks providing more complete combustion and turning the ordinary yellow flame of a kerosene lamp into the blue flame needed for cooking also nothing is screwed together but rather things either vaguely click together or are just set on each other thus not only would it be advisable to empty at least most of the fuel each time you transported it it would be necessary to find a way to keep it from banging around or turning over also when i tried it outside it seemed that even a slight breeze made the flame flutter im going to guess that fuel with force behind it like compressed gas or pressurized liquid fuel stoves is more wind resistant than dead flame stoves

illfitting parts  when i finally assembled and placed the unit on my counter i felt much better  it is a neat compact unit and the cord is not too long that it gets in the way the unit can easily be lifted from the base when cleaning the counter  the nozzle fits nicely into its holster  the attachments are all hidden within a clamshell that sits on top of the unit  this is a good thing because most people would ever use only two or three of the included attachments  incidentally if i have a complaint it is that there are not enough slots within the clamshell to fit all of the attachments i used it i had a bit of a mess but i quickly learned that the waterflow could be easily stopped temporarily by depressing a button on the nozzle  the water pressure can also be adjusted via a dial on the unit itself so for example you can use the highest setting for flossing and a lower setting for cleaning the tongue  so how well does it work  honestly my mouth feels amazing  i have not eliminated regular flossing from my regimen but this gets my mouth cleaner than brushing and flossing alone  it removes food particles plaque and even toothpaste residue from between my teeth and along the gumline leaving my mouth feeling clean and fresh  it is really surprising how much is missed by simple brushing flossing and rinsing  in conclusion this is a neat and compact little unit over the past few years ive used a panasonic electric foil shaver  the unit was reliable never having needed any change in parts and did a pretty good job of giving the best approximation to a razor blade shave therefore i hold the panasonic to my standard here  i do not use regular razor blades as they tend to give me razor burn on my rather thicker facial hair  upon unboxing i felt really frustrated right off the bat  apparently the manufacturer decided it was a brilliant move to put the contents into a blister pack inside the package box  this meant getting risk of injury just taking everything out  for a unit that costs this much this is a completely unacceptable practice charging the unit took a long time  im used to quick recharges on my panasonic but this unit took so many hours the charger uses regular cheap wire contacts for charging rather than induction like my panasonic  kind of a shocker to see this on an expensive shaver  the unit itself utilizes three rotating wheels with a unique shaving gel dispenser that you press to ooze some out on the blades  this seems like an ingenius idea but there are several downsides noticeable right off  you need to use a special shaving cream bottle as the nossle needs to inject the cream directly into the shaving unit  it might be hard just finding this type of special cream and will likely be very overpriced relative to its volume  not happy about that  the company clearly wants to reap profits on consumables  additionally it is questionable whether the cream dispenser in the unit will clog over time  this is particularly the case if you dont use the shaver for a while which allows the cream to solidify  additionally the pressure injector may fail  and finally the amount of cream stored onboard is so small that i have to inject new cream daily  seems a little too gimicky  as for the shave itself the results were lackluster  could not get the same close shave as my panasonic but the shaving cream mechanism did allow for a more pleasant shaving experience but i think i would prefer just spreading some cream manually over my face instead  the unit does not shave very quickly  i have to spend quite a bit more time getting the shave that i need  additionally my face is rather curved so getting the hairs at the top of my neck often failed so i have to touch up with a razor blade  overall i could grow on using this shaver except for the high upkeep costs and very high outlay cost of the unit itself  really the price needs to come down for this shaver to be competitive  a closer shave would be nice too  nevertheless i will continue to use this shaver for several more weeks and will post an update at that time stay tuned

i have given this cape a rating of three stars because it does not seem to be very multipurpose  its great to use for dry or slightly damp hair to keep hair or other hair product off of skin and clothes but for wet hair it does very little  with freshly shampooed hair water too easily soaks right through this cape defeating much of the purpose sure it will keep hair and product off but the person youre working on will be wet and uncomfortable where the water soaks through  this cape is great if you deal mainly with dry haircuts or style hair mostly dry  its absolutely phenomenal for that and will keep serums mousse gels andor hairspray from getting all over your client while styling their hair  if youre cutting the fabric will cause the dry hair to easily glide off and onto the floor  wet hair as i mentioned above soaks through this cape in no time flat  there seems to be little to no water resistant aspect to this cape  as such if you do mainly wet cuts or want something to keep the water of your client while blow drying their hair this is not the cape for it  the snaps and the spacing between the snaps make it great to size and fit to people from children to large adults so no complaints there  the neck itself is very comfortable as it doesnt seem to dig or bite into the neck unless of course you have it fitted too tightly but that shouldnt be an issue because the snaps are spaced well enough that you should be able to find a good fit for anyone youre working on  i received this cape as part of a product review program so i cant really be disappointed in how this cape performs  my final thoughts on this cape would be that if you work mainly with dry to only slightly damp hair it is a good value for the money spent otherwise if you work more with wetter hair purchase a different cape thats more water resistant

customer service and we worked with the unit over the phone and finally got it pumping  conairs customer service was very good no complaints  after a few months use however the conair irrigator tip attachment i was using flew off the end of the flexitube  the attached tip would no longer stay attached while under pressure the tips stay in place with a simple pressure fit click apparently there was fatigued plastic combined with perhaps a slightly toosmall size of the attachment  i called conair for a set of replacement tips  but conair amazingly said the tips were not available separately they sent me an entirely new unit  the new unit was the newer squared reservoir version  the onoff knob on the new version was very small and difficult to turn without holding onto the unit with the other hand the unit did not have rubber feet that would keep it from sliding away so to turn it on or off is a twohanded operation this is very inconvenient especially when you are holding the flosser wand in one hand after a few months use the pause button on the flosser handle burst off and water would spray out of the resulting opening the pause buttons little plastic ear had broken off under pressure  i could see that it was not repairable i thought i could maybe swap out the entire flexitube assembly with the one from my older version but this is not possible due to some small design changes internally  the parts are not interchangeable  now the waterpik  rather than try another conair i decided to try the waterpik after looking at reviews online  some others had complained that the waterpik was loud  believe me the waterpik is quiet compared with the conair it has a dampened buzz sound  vs a buzzy buzz sound the onoff button is an easy rocker style switch that allows onehanded operation without having the unit slide away the lid serves as a closed storage unit for the accessory tips a convenience  the tips are held in place with a mechanical locking mechanism  much stronger than the pressurefit technique of the conair the flexitube coils conveniently for storage into a storage compartment and the coiling storage is much easier than for the conair the best feature of this unit is the handle design the tips are inserted into a handle that has a knurled rotatable end the conair does not have this you can turn the knurled knob with your fingers which is holding your tip and aim the tip in any direction you want you do not have to rotate or contort your wrist to reach different teeth   just turn the knob to aim the jet stream where you want  this is a simple but very major convenience  the water pressure produced by the waterpik is much higher than for the conair i use the highest setting at all times many people will think that the highest setting is uncomfortable though  update  ive been very happy with the waterpick flosser but beware it does wear out over time it has a yr warranty i found that my waterpik had noticeblyreduced pressure after about  years maybe years of use im sure its pressure decreased gradually over time but i only noticed it recently so i ordered another identical waterpik feb  and the new one as i suspected has a much more powerful water stream vsmy old one i estimate that my old waterpik was providing a water stream at a level  or  on the brand new waterpik so there was a major deterioration over time and it was so gradual that i didnt really pay attention to it  my only suggestions for improving the product  a bit longer  flexitube and quiet it  down if possible but the sound level is not terrible it is simply what you might expect from a small pump  all in all the waterpik is a reliable fairly quietwelldesigned product it is heavy enough to not slide toward you while you are using it or when you push the onoff rocker switch the newer model by waterpik is apparently much lighter and has the problem of sliding during use so it seems that the older model reviewed here is the better model it so let me start off by telling you how i use this trimmer i have very short hair and about once a month i will set the trimmer on the longest length setting and just trim my entire head beard trimming outside with a handheld mirror  the vacuum is very easily clogged when trimming perhaps because i wait too long between uses but that is how i use it i dont want to trim up every single week thats one of the reasons i have a beard in the first place once the vacuum clogs you must stop the trimmer remove the length adjuster thingy and clear all the hair from the sliding vacuum trap door thingy this happens so often that there is rarely any hair in the receptacle because it all gets trapped in the vacuum orifice  another problem which is exacerbated by the need to frequently remove it is the fact the the length adjuster does not fit easily and firmly in place i often put it back on and start trimming thinking it is in place and it slides down not from pressure but because it wasnt locked into the grooves to begin with even though it felt like it was so just about every time i use it i end up with a patch of extra short hair somewhere on my head  one other thing i might mention is that this trimmer will not trim while it is plugged in you had better make sure you have enough juice in the battery to do the job before you start or you will arrive either late or halftrimmed i discovered this fact on valentines day luckily my girl thought i looked cute with multiple length hairs sticking up in all directions  these problems combined with the fact that i really miss the smaller extendable moustache blade from my old trimmer which was also nice for trimming around the ears will lead me to not buy this or any other vacuumequipped trimmer in the future in fact i may end up just sending this one over to goodwill in the near future  all these issues may not be a problem if you like to trim more regularly but this model is not for me

what a great little shaver for   i recommend it  i have used a blade for over  years and that was after many years of electric shaving remingtonbraun  i have been using a fusion for a while but the price of blades seems high they last no more than a couple weeks each and im always getting nicked around the chin area  what a lifesaver those styptic pencils are  then theres the foam and the mess  i decided to go back to electric shaving if i could find a cheaper alternative that gave me a reasonably good shave the amazon reviews indicated this series of shavers fit my requirements  i chose the slightly cheaper esk which does not have a trimmer or a carry case despite what the product description says but it does have the usual seethru snapon foil cover my first impressions were  looks like an electric shaver easy to access the cutter once you work out how to open the battery compartment cover that seems wellsealed against moisture its quite noisy with two new aa batteries but no moreso than any other electric shaver its comfortable to hold and about the size youd expect for a single blade shaver but not particularly compact for travel  unless you compare it with expensive models that are often very large when using it for the first time a dry shave at lunchtime after a fusion shave only  hours before the shave was smooth simple and fast  no nicks even where i got nicked this morning and the result is actually a really good close shave especially around the neck area  i have found that even the fusion cannot remove all the stubble on my neck without creating soreness yet without much effort this shaver has done an arguably better job  not perfect but whos going to know except my wife and she would like me to grow a beard overall this shaver seems to meet the good reviews it has received on amazon  im happy and who can complain at the price  the manual recommends a new foil every year and a cutter every two years  thats cheaper than the blades over the same time period if its true  as a reviewer said its almost worth buying more for home work the car etc you can always have a close shave because you can then shave several times a day  i will update this review when ive tried the wet shave and after a few weeks of use  update   ive tried the shaver for both dry and wet shaves  shaving was done in the morning both times  for the dry shave i showered first dried off and applied afta preelectric shave lotion at the sink  the shave was good the neck and jawline stubble took some extra time as always  generally happy with the result  the wet shave couple times in the shower spray during the shave  i found the shave more comfortable to do than the dry one and it seemed to achieve a much closer shave even though again the neck and jawline took extra time to do thoroughly after each shave i applied some liquid soap to the upright foil and ran the shaver until foam appeared on the foil surface per panasonics instructions  then rinsed the shaver under running water  this really keeps the cutting system clean and presumably sharp  much better than brushing and blowing hairs all over the sink that i had to do with my previous dryonly electric shavers  i really noticed the difference between the wet and dry shaves the following morning  the dry shave resulted in a lot of stubble the next day  the wet shave was significantly less stubble  conclusion the wet shave gives the best result and is less irritating to the skin due to the lubrication from the lotion  this little shaver really does a great job in the shower  update   used everyday and im still on the same duracell batteries i fitted when i bought the shaver  more than the  minutes battery life in the specs  update   may    finally decided to change out the ive used blonde tint on my dark dishwater blonde hair all my life so that my long thick hair is medium to light blonde  i worry about irritation to my scalp and possible hair loss so decided to try a henna product  i have white outgrowth roots on the top and crown of my head and grayish brown roots in the back  i love this product and use only this to touch up my roots on the top of my head  mixed with only lemon juice to a thin yogurt consistency leaving it on my roots for  hours it completely changes my white roots to blondecompletely  the last hour i cover the rest of my hair outer layer with the cassia to enhance the color and condition my already blonde from processing over the years hair so it blends  however this product will not lighten or change the color of my graybrown outgrowth so i still have to use a regular blonde tint on the roots of the rest of my head  so my hair project takes a few hours each month    first i make  inch parts all over the back and lower sides of my head not where i have white outgrowth then apply blonde tint to the outgrowth only and leave it on  minutes or so according to directions  then i wash and dry my hair  next i mix the cassie with lemon juice and let it sit about a half hour  then i make narrow parts on the top of my head then apply the cassia henna to the roots on top and crown of my head with a thin paint brush  letting it sit for an hour the mixture cools my scalp  after an hour passes i paint the remaining henna over my entire outer layers of hair roots to end let it sit for another hour  and wash completely  its time consuming but perfect for me

my expectations for any antiaging product are pretty modest  i think that certain products can make your skin tone appear more even resulting in a brighter complexion and skin that reflects light prettily tends to appear more youthful  i do not think that there are any miracle creams out there that are going to make you look decades younger and i find most of the hype surrounding many antiaging products is just that  hype with no science to back it up  that being said  skii is a wellknown highend skin care line and i was excited to give it a try  this product arrived without any instructions which i find odd  does it replace your toner or do you use it after your toner  i had to go online to the companys website to do a little research  you apply this product to clean skin  you can use a cotton pad or pat it into the skin with your hands  it absorbs into my skin quickly and completely theres no sticky feeling nor is it oily  it has the consistency of water and a very slight and not unpleasant odor  i experience no stinging redness irritation or breakouts  this does leave my skin feeling a little tight and i follow up with my usual daytime moisturizer and nighttime retinol cream  after nearly four weeks of use twice daily i have to say that ive noticed absolutely no change in my skin whatsoever  now im pretty happy with my current skin care regimen and its entirely possible that what im using is effective and im not going to see any major changes by adding another product into the mix  bottom line  pleasant and easy to use no unwanted side effects but also no noticeable improvement  would i recommend this product  hard to say  everyones skin is different and ive read online testimonials by women who swear by this stuff  since it didnt do anything for me i cant be too enthusiastic about it and frankly i find the price a bit prohibitive

im going to dwell on the installation of these things because frankly you may never get past that point if youre in a manualselfpropelled wheelchair you know how important grip can be standard aluminum pushrims the things you grab to rotate the big wheels of the chair are slick and force you to expend a lot of energy just holding on some kind of coating or jacket that lets you grab and dig in can be immensely helpful in reducing fatigue and increasing range and mobility  youll want to conserve your energy too because getting fit grips on will probably take the last of it it took two people working hard for  minutes to get one fit grip on the pushrim and we were exhausted and sore by the time we were done and yep we followed the directions  pros cons and cautions  pro if you can possibly get them on the pushrim fit grips do the job of gripping very well they have just enough give to allow your hands to dig in they stay with you when youre slowing your progress down a steep ramp or catching yourself as you push up a slope  howeverbig con installation is close to impossible without assistance these things are made of very stiff thick rubber with little indentations to fit the pushrim tabs the instructions say to grab the rim and stretch it every six inches until the rim is significantly longer i tried it its about like stretching a bicycle tire if you have any kind of disability that interferes with upper body strength remember these things are for people in wheelchairs good luck with that  youre working to push the grip down onto the rim while its contracting back up the instructions suggest using zip ties to hold sections down as you get them on the wheel and thats what we did we wound up with ties every four inches or so wrestling each section into place every so often wed need to go back and undo the tie roll the grip back into position and then ziptie it again  the moment of truth when you snip off the last ziptie and your grip stays in place is wonderfuluntil you realize that theres a second grip to install  medium con the grips dont cover the entire pushrim but stop about halfway i thought theyd cover the whole rim especially with all that effort but they dont i had some adhesive crud left from my old grips and assumed the new would cover it up no such luck  minor quibble i ordered the red grips and theyre not red but more of a magenta i happen to hate pink so it was a little disappointing after the wrestling match i went through getting them on im not about to exchange them for a better color  caution the description says these grips are for  and  inch pushrims my wheelchair has inch wheels but inch pushrims and i was afraid these would be way too big obviously theyre not and id really really hate to try and squeeze these over a inch pushrim i suspect that when the manufacturer says inch pushrim they actually mean the wheel itself that would make more sense  all in all they do the job intended if they could figure out a way to make installation less painful id give them more stars

i began using a waterpik in the mid s upon the advice of my orthodontist  that unit came with one basic classic pik which worked fine  the pressure setting on that machine was plenty strong enough if set at three or four  much more than that was too high pressure for me  that old unit had a compact design with a slim profile too so it took up less space than this ultra water flosser and it possessed a modicum of simple elegance  after twenty plus years my old waterpik finally died  i read rave reviews about this model on amazon  amazon reviewers can usually be trusted to tell the good the bad and the ugly  the good reviews of this model were plentiful so i bought it  i used it for the first time today and i must say i am extremely disappointed in it  below are the pros and cons from my viewpoint  pro    with the pressure setting set to ten this unit is better than nothing but not much  it will help flush out larger food particles from between the teeth  con    this unit is far too large and takes up far more than its fair share of space on the vanity and even in the cupboard below  its large bulky design has absolutely no sense of elegance to it  steve jobs and apple brought the concept of sleek elegant design some even say sexy to computers and other electronics and made a fortune  waterpik seems to be going in the exact opposite direction  big bulky and ugly are the only words to describe this unit  it is a space hog with no visual appeal whatsoever  it reminds me of what those old office adding machines look like in comparison to a hand held calculator that uses a microchip  the old adding machines were big bulky and took up a lot of room on a desk top but the new calculators took up the merest corner of the desk top and slipped easily into a lap drawer whence not in use  whilst everyone else has been pursuing smaller size and a more elegant profile over the last forty years or more waterpik seems to be opting for ungainly bulkiness    the plastic feels positively flimsy compared to my old waterpik  waterpik customer service told me this is because the plastic in this unit is more readily biodegradable than the old type of plastic  the woman said new laws prevent them from using the old type of plastic  i am in favour of anything that helps the environment but this still feels as though this plastic will not hold up for very many years  the box says made in china and everything about this unit definitely shouts very cheaply made in china    the extra specialised tips do not seem to be of any real value  they are nothing more than bells and whistles that the manufacturer uses to justify charging more money for the product  the classic tip is all anyone needs and i vouchsafe this statement based on the fact that i wore braces for five years  all i ever used for more than twenty years was the basic classic tip and i have always had excellent dental checkups even during the five years i wore braces  moreover although i am a very experienced waterpik user i flooded my vanity trying these specialised tips  to use these specialised tips one has to look into the mirror to see what one is doing  looking into the mirror means raising ones head to mirror height  raising ones head to mirror height whilst using these specialised tips causes water to go absolutely everywhere  i did not have this problem even the first time i used the old model with just the basic classic tip    the water pressure on this unit is not the same as the old model i used for twenty years  as another reviewer commented and i heartily agree the old model had plenty of pressure set at three or four  this model has to be turned up to ten to approach the pressure of the old model set at three or four  even set at ten it does not feel strong enough to me and it certainly is not equal to my old waterpiks pressure set at ten  waterpik customer service told me that they had a bad batch of these a few years ago where the motors were not strong enough  she suggested that i had gotten one of those models  i had her check the serial number and the model number of my unit  it was manufactured in  so it is not one from their bad batch a few years ago    on the lower settings this model does not pick between the teeth so much as it simply floods them with a very weak stream of water  taking a mouthful of water and swishing it around in ones mouth creates more pressure than this unit creates on the lower settings  waterpik customer service said this model has a different type of motor than the old ones had and uses less electricity  really  well speaking for myself i would rather pay a few extra dollars a year on electricity and have the old motor  by way of analogy there are low flush commodes and low flow shower heads on the market too and i have used them before but i certainly would never intentionally install one in my bathroom  why  because the pressure is too insubstantial  i want to feel a strong shower if i am going to shower and i want to feel a strong pressure from my waterpik if i am going to water floss my teeth  in conclusion after twenty plus years as a user of a waterpik i am deeply disappointed in this unit  large bulky and totally aesthetically unappealing plastic that feels cheap and insubstantial a motor that feels underpowered assorted specialised tips that really do nothing more or better than the basic classic tip and waterpiks customer services attitude of you are wrong this is just as good if not better than the old model all lead me to give this unit a big thumbs down  as for waterpiks customer service representative please know that the customer is never wrong  i do not believe this unit will give you any better oral health than using an electric toothbrush floss and a manual tongue scraper followed by a good mouthwash  if anyone is interested in buying mine at a substantial discount please feel free to contact me oneoldreaderyahoocom

the sonicare uv sanitizer uses a small but strong light bulb inside a chromepainted plastic housing to kill electric toothbrush bacteria on a daily basis  all one needs to do is shake the water from the brush head insert it into the capsule close the door and push a button  ten minutes later when the small green light stops blinking the brush head is free of at least  of bacteria dont think about the other ten percent  does it work  since im not a microbiologist i cant say for sure but all the warnings that come with the box suggest that the light is powerful enough to do the necessary damage  the sanitizer comes with adaptors that accommodate brush heads of multiple brands of electric toothbrushes  sonicare oral b and braun  not only do the adaptors address difference in bottom connectors round or rectangular but they also adjust for differences in height to keep the bristles at the right level  users can insert the larger sonicare brush assembly or a much smaller oral b brush or both at the same time  see product picture for illustration  since i use an electric toothbrush only once a day and use a traditional brush at other times i wish that the housing could fit regular brushes as well  that feature might make this product nearly perfect  unfortunately the unit sterilizes only the brush heads and not the entire brush  this means that the interior needs to be cleaned at least once a week if not more often because of the salivaandwater mix that drains from inside the brush and down its sides  the bottom tray and adaptors snap out fairly easily for cleaning however it would be nice if the entire interior compartment emerged germfree  although the sanitizer comes with strict warnings about not touching the bulb making it not appropriate for use in the bathrooms of young children it does have the safety feature of shutting off if the door is opened during operation the canceled operation wont cool the bulb but it will stop the uv radiation  the plastic bulb housing seems to protect the bulb adequately from all but the tiniest fingers  im not even sure toddler fingers could get in although kids have been known to defeat a host of safety devices  the unit is lightweight and compact enough to pack on a trip for those who travel with their electric toothbrushes and who dont like the idea of invisible germs lurking in their bristles even for a few days  all youll need is a standard outlet and a small flat surface to set it up  i like the sonicare uv santizer for its easy of use  maybe its giving me a false sense of security since i cant tell whether it works or not but ignorance can indeed be bliss

detailing shower tool is essentially a nylon sponge marketed for men and intended to be used with the axe brand of body washes the liquid soap alternative to the ubiquitous bar but really any body wash will do  about the size of a grapefruit cut in half it has two distinct features a spongy coil of nylon for general cleaning and a multicolored scrubber that is similar to looped portion of a velcro closure for less sensitive parts like calluses or soles of feet it has ring that keeps the two parts together that feels great in your hand under all circumstances moreso when its wet slippery with soap and rubbing it around yourself building up a lather  the one feature would like to emphasize is the hardiness sponge  its difficult to relate how something feels but i suppose that the best behave like large cotton balls in everyway but this axe brand tool truly is made for men because you will feel it  the stiff nylon sponge will easily scour off the grime of irregular bathing or a days worth of work if you work a bluecollar job now i am rather active man who can build up a layer sweat with my outdoor work and can easily find an excuse not to shower everyday but no matter what my circumstances are now i know that the detailer is going to get me clean  i have seen women and effeminate men submit themselves to these luxury spa skin treatments and get tangible results i have to admit i felt like those people but without the vanity and narcissism  if you are looking to move up in personal hygiene the axe detailer is a leap in male cleanliness  the almost scratchy feel may not be to everyone taste but soft girly bright nylon sponges did not feel like they could get the job either  about only negative is that is best you use a body wash with an antibacteria quality because i first bought a norelco rotating reflex head shaver in the late s  i was a grad student with very little money but scraped enough together to buy the razor expensive back then because a close friend recommended it  this technology immediately proved to give a terrific easy shave and i have stayed with the norelco shaver line ever since  the socalled lift and cut configuration has two sets of angled stacked blades in the rotating shaver head and i have every reason to believe that norelcos illustrations and claims of their special effectiveness are correct   for many years i simply bought the least expensive norelco reflex razor every few years and did not bother with replacement heads a set of heads costs more than half of what the lowestpriced razor model costs  razor performance during this period of about  years was always great  as the saying goes they will have to pry these razors out of my cold dead hands   then with the advent of amazon and ebay my approach changed in recent years  instead of buying new razors i began saving some money by buying sets of new replacement heads on amazon  also i really liked the lowend powerful norelco lc model that norelco had discontinued it is not rechargeable but is great for travel because it is  volt  so more recently i bought a few used lcs on ebay and set them aside so that i would always have at least one for many years to come   after a few years of using replacement heads from amazon it gradually dawned on me that shaving had become a lot harder  it took a lot more time more passes and harder pressure to complete a shave  the degradation in shaving experience was kind of subtle at first but eventually i reached the conclusion that maybe something was really really wrong with the replacement heads  and it got to be very irritating indeed figuratively and literally   i also bought and tried vollco sharpening heads which are designed to hone the edges of worndown norelco reflex razor heads but these did not succeed at all in getting me back to a great easy shave   i reluctantly began to consider the possibility that the replacement heads from amazon were counterfeit  on the face of it this seems pretty improbable because the head blades themselves are very intricate little devices with very close dimensional tolerances  it seemed impossible that counterfeiters would develop the expensive equipment and processing skill to make a crummy imitation version of norelcos heads and still hope to make money on them  also the replacement heads from amazon look excatly like those in a new razor even under magnification   nonetheless about  months ago i decided to do a test by purchasing replacement heads directly from the norelco website  i put a couple of sets into the shopping cart and tried to check out but the process repeatedly failed and i gave up back then  what are the odds right  i figured maybe i was just wasting my time   however a few weeks ago i traveled to see my sister and brotherinlaw and i threw one of my used razors from ebay into my carryon  now one thing i learned early on with these razors is that you have to empty out the shavings every time you use them in order to avoid buildup and jamming  so every morning i pull off the head assembly and tap it against the sink   to my surprise on the first morning using the ebay razor there was about twice as much whisker material down the wall of the sink bowl as i was accustomed to seeing after every shave  it was pretty dramatic especially given that the razor had been used for an unknown number of shaves before i bought it on ebay   so when i got home a few days later i went back to the norelco website and persevered until with their customer service help i got two sets of replacement heads ordered and delivered  two days ago i loaded in a new set and turned on the razor   big surprise at the outset  it actually sounded noticeably different from what i had generally been hearing from various norelco razors and head sets over the years  and the shave was finally terrific and easy again  i did not expect this at all because it seems so completely improbable that someone would go to the trouble of counterfeiting these intricate little devices   but with three new facts in hand changed sound more whisker material and really great fast shave again the conclusion however improbable seems incontrovertible  there is something wrong with the replacement heads   all things considered my best guess is that these replacement heads sold on amazon actually do come from the same factory in china where the good ones from norelco are made but are somehow being diverted and stolen from the production line at a point before some sort of final critical manufacturing steps is carried out   for example though im not a metallurgist i do know that there are some highly specialized techniques and expensive equipment for hardening the surfaces of cutting edges such as by using metal sputtering or ion implantation to harden just the first few layers of atoms on a metallic surface or edge  these techniques can create highly specialized alloy surfaces or whatever   if norelcos factory has high security for heads emerging from a final processing step but misses diversion and theft of heads from an earlier point in the production process that would explain all the facts without having to invoke the idea of a totally separate counterfeiting plant   obviously i will buy replacement heads only from norelco in the future   i hope this review helps some people  i will be happy to provide whatever information i can to help skeptics understand that this review is genuine  for example i have i emails from norelcos website showing my failed purchase attempt much earlier this year and the successful purchase a week ago plus ii records of all my ebay razor purchases and iii my purchases of replacement heads from amazon  feb   feb   dec   dec   aug   aug   july   and the vollco sharpeners on aug     i have nothing to gain from publicizing this information  im just very pleased indeed with the outcome and grateful to norelco for putting out a fine product for several decades now  ps  now that i have read some other reviews of these replacement heads it seems possible that there actually is also a counterfeit production source because some reviewers said that the screens and blades failed immediately  this would not happen with heads diverted from an intermediate step the norelco production process  i would guess that we are now deaing with at least two sources of problems with the replacement heads  or maybe norelco retains control of one source that makes the highquality heads that are available on norelcos website but also enabled some other less capable source to make the heads that work so poorly

sonicare my regime for over  years was to use regular brush floss then sonicare every morning and brush every night this staved off any recurrence of periodontal disease that i first had when in japan in  visits to the dentist first every three months then stretched to six months and then sometimes as much as a year without any evidence of periodontal pockets or significant tarter buildup between visits  however in early  my dentist recommended that i use a waterpik i decided to take my chances i found none of the difficulties such as others complained about using the device itself after six months of use i wrote my first review giving the waterpik a fivestar rating the hose had remained coupled to the pumping station the handle remained in one piece and the pressure regulation worked fine  i really do not have recourse to use all the differing ends they provide i use the standard end and mary uses the tinyjet high velocity end for periodontal pockets so far so good this true as i update as it was when first reviewed  afte purchase i decided to test the efficacy of the waterpik by eliminating the use of floss after close to a year i went again to my dentist and he found significant tarter much more than in past examinations as stated my previous regime of brush floss sonicare resulted in negligible tarter with as much as three years between visits we worked on a boat in the caribbean and could not always get dental care now i know that the waterpik helpsi can see this after eating things such as nuts then flossing then using the pik but it is not a replacement for floss  i should mention my method of flossing because it probably is significant to this review i hold the floss wrapped around one little finger and around the other hand stretching the floss between the two hands i go up and down between the teeth on the teeth edges fourtosix times i do this for each edge side of each tooth up and down  my current regime is brush waterpik floss sonicare this seems to do the job as a result of my experience i have reduced the overall rating of the waterpik to threestar while it should receive a fivestar rating if only the quality of the device is considered the overall determination should be the quality of the results and this to me is threestar based on its efficacy  my conclusion is that the waterpik is insufficient by itself to eliminate buildup of tarter rather its combined use with floss is surely the best combination with brushing but if you have to choose between the two choose flossits consistent use will stand you in good stead the  speedxl model is the first time ive tried using a norelco shaver in almost a decade and the results have been superior to earlier models equaling the closeness of shave seen with midrange foil models from braun or remington there are some caveats however as the head is less well suited to going over any given area of the face a single time and has more difficulty with the areas above and below the lips unfortunately the attached trimmer is one of the worst designs ive seen unless you use it exclusively for thinning out your beard hair   this particular unit is very quiet for an electric and is possessed of a nimh rechargeable battery making it less apt to developing a crippling memoryeffect this is a plus and while the battery capacity is not the absolute best the shaver does seem to recharge rather rapidly the nimh battery also reduces the mass of the shaver the seemingly lowpowered motors add little more making this a very light shaver for its size    while the closeness of shave is quite comparable to pivoting foilhead models from braun and some of the dualfoil remingtons the norelco seems to require going over the same section of skin more times the area of the head of the shaver is of course larger so there are fewer total sections to shave but the norelco does seem to take a bit longer with plenty of touch up needed above and below the lips the top of the chin and the neck overall however a very close shave is possible without using a mirror beware of shaving with only one of the heads however as on curvy area of the upper lip as skin can get pulled uncomfortably    norelco touts this shaver as being directly washable but i would not wash the razor more than monthly rather mopping up the inside with a piece of tissue three or four times a week if you have thick quickly growing hair also note that the head section dries rather slowly and should probably be shook vigorously dry before reattaching    the popup trimmer is a disappointment as it seems much lowerpowered than remington or braun trimmers requiring more attention in use than it should much like the head of the shaver the trimmer must go over the same section multiple times to get the job done its not possible to do precise trimming with a corner of the trimmer and it is also definitely wider than is preferable for precise trimming still worse the trimmer has even more of a tendency to fold back into the main unit than the competition the sole saving grace of the lowpowered trimmer is that it is probably the best design going for trimming and thinning out large areas of beard mustache and sideburn    barring the trimmer and using care when shaving the upper lip this is a high quality design that should stand the test of time since it does not have an easily tearable foil or a bendable head that require replacement it should also be cheaper to maintain over the long term unless one washes it daily finally the percieved level of irritation induced by the shaver seems comparable to remingtonbraun and less than the thinfoil panasonics  if you can get around the trimmer and the trade offs inherent in the head design this shaver is one of the better units on the market and should serve you well for many years

before the written word stories were passed on orally something enjoying a minor comeback these days and in black diamond zakes mda has his storys narrator mimic this ancient mode of storytelling if youre a reader committed to the modern techniques of the novel much of what you read here may very well grate still theres mdas story which is at least as engaging as the most popular genre fiction of today the difference though is that this book also informs readers of postapartheid life in south africa so what is mdas story  don mateza a former black revolutionary and now an up and coming member of security firm is in a flawed romantic liaison with tumi an ambitious owner of a modeling agency don is given the job of protecting a white magistrate kristin uys who has sent stevo visagie a member of a tough but minor crime family to prison stevos family threatens kristin and its dons job to balance his professional duties to the magistrate against his decaying involvement with tumi i hesitate to go on with the story at this point i might be accused of revealing too much suffice it to say that mda handles the intertwined fates of the visage family don kristin and tumi quite well  the title by the way is a term for a member of the increasingly affluent black middle class in south africa mda does himself proud in his depictions of postapartheid life in the former black community of soweto the lives of black south africans living respectable middle class lives and others still living on the perimeter of that society the slow emergence of blacks and whites finding ways to live and work together im one who isnt enthralled with mdas choice of voice and narrative style but the books content makes it a worthy read  my rating  of  stars
