i have had the norelco xl for a few weeks now and overall im pretty satisfied  the shaver has good and not so good points so lets look at them  pros  very good shaving results on the relatively smooth unobstructed parts of my face  cheeks chin and the neck are where this shaver shines  just press lightly and move the shaver in a circular motion for a very close quick and comfortable shave  light weight and very quiet in operation  much quieter than my old braun shaver  good battery life  looks like the shaver will need a recharge no more than once per week  the recharging cord is long enough to allow you to use this as a corded shaver while it is recharging  thats a real convenience if you are in a hurry and find that your shaver battery is dead  easy to clean  just pop the top open and rinse with hot water  cons  the ergonomics of the shaving head leave a lot to be desired  the shaving head is big and bulky and that makes it very awkward when you are trying to shave relatively small areas like your upper lip  this is the major drawback of this norelco and probably all rotarytype shavers and i still often use my old braun foiltype shaver on my lip  you must follow norelcos instructions exactly when shaving tender areas such as your neck  specifically do not press the shaver too hard against your skin  if you do you will be rewarded with olympicsize skin irritation  i can personally vouch for the truth of this statement    i bought this shaver when my old braun free control  shaver began to show signs of needing a replacement shaving head and i found that the price of the shaving head was too close to the price of a complete new shaver  so i thought i would try this norelco which is in approximately the same price range as my braun  ie  they are both on the cheap end of their product lines  the bottom line on this norelco is that it does some things really well like shaving my cheeks and neck  it does these areas better and more quickly than my braun foiltype shaver  but the norelco does some things badly like shaving my upper lip  the braun  shavers head gets into tight areas much better but shaving is slower and noisier overall with the braun  the real issue here is probably whether you like rotary or foiltype shavers  both can be very good but only at some aspects of shaving your face  as far at this particular norelco goes it seems to be a pretty good representative of the rotary type of shaver  if you like rotary shavers this norelco is probably as good as any  whatever faults this norelco may have seem to be common to all rotary shavers and not because of any defect in this particular model  so dont throw your money at the more expensive norelcos thinking that they will be better  you wont change the nature of the beast you will just be getting a nicer looking beast with more bells and whistles

without much effort  ive used these kinds of things before and i applied them exactly as directed no polish under or over i have squarish nail beds so i used a pair of embroidery scissors to cut the wraps before taking them off the plastic and applying them over my nails then used the scissors to trim off the excess i have pretty short nails so i didnt use a lot of each wrap  i felt they stuck well enough and i enjoyed seeing some color on my nails for a change i noticed they had a slight texture to them which made them feel and look more like real nail polish i did notice that the print quality was kind of spotty in some places you could see the inkjet dots and in another place the ink had smeared a tiny bit dragging a faint black line through several of the wraps so the printing quality left a bit to be desired  they didnt last long the first one simply disappeared from my pinkie after a shower the next morning throughout the next day others started to peel off especially after washing my hands it seems if it starts to peel the minute the adhesive under the wrap comes in contact with water the whole thing slides off after id lost three on one hand and one on the other i peeled the rest of them off  so it seems that this product is probably best for shortterm wear maybe out clubbing or for a girls night out or something similar expecting these to last more than a couple of days is unrealistic  if you accept that they are temporary bling and not meant to replace a real manicure then youll be happy with the effect of having fun funky nails for a short time  i ive been a loyal philips sonicare user my current model being the sonicare flexcare for many years sonicare brushes work by emitting a sonic vibration that vibrates the bristles quickly cleaning your teeth far more effectively than a manual toothbrush the difference is like night and day  my biggest gripe with my sonicare is that sometimes it doesnt clean as effectively as id like right up by my gum line i was intrigued by the rotating head on oral bs brush thinking that perhaps the rotating action would do a better job at cleaning these areas i really had high hopes for this toothbrush and was excited to give it a try  this kit includes a precision  toothbrush with charger optional brush head storage area with lid that can be easily connectedremoved to the charging base four different brush heads a smartguide device and a travelstorage case for the toothbrush according to the manual this brush will hold a charge through  uses twice per day for  days so for shorter trips theres no need to bring the charger along  my first impression of this brush is that its heavier and more stout than my sonicare this isnt a complaint necessarily just an observation the toothbrush sets nicely on the charging base and charges with no exposed metal parts for an item that is constantly getting wet this is a great feature  the rotating action did actually do a better job at thoroughly cleaning my teeth than my sonicare because of this action however the toothbrush vibrates a lot more than my sonicare and the vibrations are more rough this is something that im getting used to though like my sonicare the toothbrush pauses and beeps when its time to move to a new area of your mouth which is a great feature  the smartguide device is really neat it actually communicates with the toothbrush and tells you if youre pressing too hard it also displays the quadrants of your mouth and helps guide you to which quadrant you should be brushing during each interval since ive been using an electric toothbrush for so many years already i dont see myself using this device very often the toothbrush operates just fine without using the smartguide device which i personally appreciate  my biggest complaint about this brush is that the shafts of the brush heads have openings in them im not sure why this is but these openings allow liquefied toothpaste and whatnot to escape your mouth while brushing and it can end up on your toothbrush andor hand gross im sure this is one of those issues that will remedy itself as i get used to this brush but thought it was worth mentioning my sonicare brush has no such openings on the brush heads so i wasnt expecting this  the items included in this kit small bottle of mouthwash toothpaste and dental floss are nice for sampling these products but the winner is  the panasonic ess blade  barely put the remington blades and cutter keeping the center blade of the panasonic on a panasonic  rpm shaver and you would have the worlds best electric shaver the remington shaved a little closer than the panasonic and provided a faster shave however the difficulty in cleaning noise and lack of a charging base tipped me to the panasonic as the final choice  this is a review of three panasonic models esa blade ess blade and es the remington ms the norelco  cc and the braun series      only differ in displays and cleaning i have an average beard and have been using electric shavers foils and rotaries over  years the models here are no better than any of the other higher quality shavers ive owned it takes about  minutes no shaver will give you a firstpass close shave to get to that good dry shave with or without preelectric gelsoils and you do have to put pressure on to get a close shave this means recharging every  days gelsoils do make the process easier  not faster  and i have reviewed six of them on their amazon sites  ess this blade shaver gives a very close shave with some work it does give off a higher pitch whine while shaving that is somewhat annoying but is not what i would consider noisy nor is the cleaning operation noisy based upon other reviewers i was expecting it to sound like a lawn mower but it is just an occasional buzzing noise as it cleans the arc foil design slows shaving see discussion below  esa i had hoped that the four blades of the panasonic esa just might be able to give a superior shave as it turns out the large fourblade surface is like trying to keep the end of a x on your face it makes cutting in the areas where you dont have a lot of skin area chin jaw line upper lip base of sideburns etc more difficult in fact i think that the fourth blade in the middle actually interferes with a better shave and these two middle blades are not as good as the primary cutters the arc foil design makes it even slower see discussion below another future problem with the blade system is that youll want to buy a new shaver when your blades and foil need to be replaced what kind of an idiot is going to spend  of the cost of a new shaver just to get a set of new cutter blades and foil all in all the esa blade is a poor value  ess the flat design of the foil is a better design than the arc foil see below unfortunately this shaver has an underpowered motor and the floating head that cannot be locked  panasonic discussion panasonic had developed an outstanding shaver line some ten years ago my old es still shaves closer than this new nano technology a misnomer marketing gimmick i think the reason is that panasonics older models came with cutting blades with the individual blades having been about half the width of all of panasonics newer cutting blades including replacements this means more surface area on the newer blades and that means less cutting remington has the ideal blades that panasonic used to make and it shows in closer cutting and less time spent doing so additionally these new panasonic arc foil shavers have the foil curving away from your face at the ends of the foil further decreasing exposure to the blades and requiring many more passes to cover the same area unfortunately panasonic puts their better motor  rpms only on these illconceived arc foil designs battery time on the panasonics is the shortest of all shavers reviewed here the panasonic trimmers are so narrow on all of these models that you will not be able to trim sideburns with one attempt you will have to reposition the trimmer to get what you missed this increases the probability that you will get an uneven sideburn  the remington ms has the blades that the panasonics should have and did have years ago flat foil area not arc foiled good length  longer and ultra thin cutting blades as a result closeness of the shave is better and time spent is shorter this is however the loudest and it is loud of all shavers and there are no bells and whistles using a preshave oilgel will gum up the blades as with any shaver but these blades pop off with even the slightest brushing so be prepared to watch them fall into the sink with every cleaning attempt a charging stand would greatly increase the convenience of this shaver remington did a poor job with the details  the braun series   tries hard you can hear noticeable slowing when necessary pressure is applied like a lawn mower when it reaches thicker grass but it doesnt get quite as close as the panasonics or remington without leaving a stronger burning sensation after the shave the braun can also leave burn marks and even cuts nose and lips that will bleed odd you would think that with it getting so close as to actually burn the skin it would also give a closer shave i suppose this is proof that shavers cannot lift hairs to cut better additionally the design of the handle is inferior making positioning more difficult it does have a much wider trimmer and longer battery life between charges though  the norelco  cc i used this rotarytype of shaver for many years during the s i switched to foil and found i could get a closer shave this is still the case additionally because of the circular blades it is somewhat difficult to target certain spots for cleanup however this is the quietest shaver  ps dont accept the nonsense about giving your face  days to adjust unless you are coming off a blade if you are accustomed to an electric shaver you only need a week or two to determine the difference the lightener it also comes with a little mixing bowl and an applicator brush the instructions state to mix  oz of the developer but it comes with a  oz bottle additionally part of the instructions said slots right on the wall of that compartment they could have switched the credit card slots to the other side  i did not overstuff  all i had in that pocket was the little chapstick  certainly dont plan on carrying anything with any dimension in this pocket at most you could fit a black plastic comb or a bookmark  i dont know if it was because of the chapstick or because of a miscalculation in sewing  but i couldnt get  row of the credit card slots to hold any cards at all they seemed too narrow   the back pocket is lined for phones or sunglasses but the angle of the pouch and the velcro closure made me nervous about putting my touch screen phone in this pouch  it felt like it might pop open and the phone could only fit in without its little case  theres no other place in the purse which would accommodate a phone so unless you have an older tiny light weight clamshell phone or one you dont care about too much  youre out of luck  also this pocket is only gusseted for dimension in unfolded it never goes all the way flat again adding yet more ungainly bulk to the bag  if you try to just stuff it back in forget it  you must fold the bag in exactly the way it came out a feat that requires a little patience  if youre bad at folding maps just forget it   the two straps for carrying on your shoulder or around your waist  are very thin and located on either side of the main zippered area which makes it awkward to get into the wallet area   the bag is made of a stiff canvas material and is therefore not very lightweight  pros  when unfolded the tote bag is much more useful and seems very sturdy and roomy   you could use it just as a tote bag and never fold it back up with the wallet and sunglasses pouches still accessible on the exterior for trips to the beach i suppose  though there are more fashionable plain old totes for that purpose   someone who carries only a card and some bills or coins and sunglasses to the farmers market or on garage sale trips might i have been cursed with a coarse beard and sensitive skin and i recently came to the conclusion that i will have to shave every day if i want to have a smooth shave with little to no razor bumps  blemishes  ive been using mach blades for a some time with mediocre results  maybe because i havent been shaving every day  so i wanted to switch to something better and cheaper  atra blades are much less expensive than most other blades eg fusion but it just doesnt work for me and i think i may know why my shaving technique sucks  the angle of the blade when shaving is very important  the pivot point of the atra is in the middle of the blade which acts like a seesaw fulcrum if you have the right pressure but a slightly wrong angle the atra will pivot to a more correct angle and shave well if you have the wrong pressure but a good angle it may result in irritation and if both your pressure and angle are bad like me then it may result in irritation with nicks and cuts and razor burn  unlike the atra the pivot point of the mach is at the bottom of the blade if the angle is wrong then the mach will pivot to a better angle if the pressure is a little too strong the machs pivot will also correct for that and if both the pressure and the angle are bad then the mach may result in a good shave regardless of how much your shaving technique sucks  more blades may mean more irritation for people with sensitive skin so mach is the highest i want to go  if there is a cheaper twoblade razor with a bottom pivot then i will try it  i noticed similar irritation when i used the sensor twoblade razor and i think that the reason was due to the pivot point and my poor technique  i really wanted to keep using the atra because the price is much better but it just didnt work for me  if i ever learn good technique then i will start using a doubleedge safety razor but until then its mach for me

let me start out by saying that i was really angered by the amount of packaging this shaver came in  it came in a cardboard box and inside that was a sealed plastic clamshell that you have to use heavy scissors to cut through and inside of that there was more plastic and cardboard  one would think that a large modern company especially a european company would be more environmentally conscious  the good news is that the clear plastic that nonfood products come packaged in can now be recycled with your cans and bottles in many if not most localities  if you buy a product that comes in a bubble glued to a piece of cardboard you should separate the two and then recycle the plastic with your cans and bottles and the cardboard with your paper and cardboard the economics of recycling dont allow recyclers to pay someone to separate plastic from cardboard so you need to do that yourself  ive been using norelco shavers for  years  this shaver is both better and worse than their older shavers  the actual shaving performance is much better  i have an older plugin norelco shaver and while shaving i have to rub my face a couple times with a hot washcloth to raise my whiskers  i dont have to raise my whiskers with this new shaver meaning that i can shave my face dry and get a close shave  in fact the shave is so close that it leaves my skin a little sore  in actual practice i still drag a hot moist washcloth across my face to make sure all my whiskers are raised  this shaver is also very quiet so it doesnt hurt my ears  on the down side the trimmer doesnt work as well as the plugin shaver that i already own  it doesnt take hair off as well and it doesnt stand out at a far enough angle  also the shaver part will sometimes pull long hairs instead of cutting them off and that can be painful  in my opinion both the trimmer performance and the tendency to pull hairs is due to this being a batteryoperated shaver meaning that the cutters dont have as much power behind them as a plugin shaver  plugin shavers have more robust performance but they are louder  i cant tell you how many shaves the charge is good for because i shave every  days  i get three shaves out a charge but then i shave much longer than if i were shaving every day  if the shaver loses it charge during a shave youll have to plug it in and wait five minutes for it to charge slightly before continuing  you then have to complete your shave with the plug in  one good thing is that norelco shavers now come with straight cords instead of a coiled cords  the coiled cords were a nuisance  i have some concerns about the onoff button  it is one of those soft molded plastic buttons that deforms when you push it instead of a normal mechanical switch  my experience with such buttons is that the plastic eventually fatigues and cracks  i doubt it will last as long as the rest of the shaver lasts  in short  great shaving performance soso popup trimmer environmentally unfriendly packaging

i paid over  for three bottles  id like to get some of the free bottles coming my way  ive yet to see a thorough review from a guy who is using this as an alternate to rogaine or equivalent a key ingredient of this supplement is the the minoxidil alternative eclipta alba  ill definitely be coming back here and writing an indepth review of my experience with this product  update   ok so im finally returning to give a more indepth review of my experience with toji  ill also be concluding with some key comments about tojis customer service which id give stars  though technically this review is for the product  i say this because i think the goal of a review is to keep it as objective and as true to the usage of the product as possible  like many people whove stumbled upon toji i was intrigued by the ingredient eclipta alba the herbal alternative to minoxidil  and in my case i wanted to see how it worked for male pattern baldness  i bought three bottles and toji did send me a free bottle  for my testing period i didnt quite make it through the fourth bottle so it was a bit less than four months total that i took toji  the instructions on the bottle suggest a minimum of six months usage by the way  i took four pills a day  in the am and  in the pm  im very sensitive to supplements and medications but these didnt have any adverse effect on me  i took photos of my temples front and top at start monthly and finish of the testing period  in addition because i wanted to approach this like many users of minoxidil i continued to use a  ketoconazole shampoo which i had already been using prior to toji  at almost four months of usage my personal experience was that toji did not help me with hair regrowth or hair loss though it did seem to improve the overall quality of my hair  making it shiny and strong  part of the reason for my stoppage of the test was due to my research of eclipta alba which as another commenter mentioned was only applied topically not orally in any of the studies that i found online  toji would obviously be taken orally in pill form  in addition i could not find any clinical studies with male patients only women or lab rats  mind you there very well may be studies out there with male patients i just didnt find any  but ultimately the main reason for stopping the supplement is that i didnt see any obvious results  so though ive concluded that toji didnt work for me and my male pattern baldness it may be beneficial for those looking to boost the quality of the hair they have  it may work better for some guys than it did for me for hair loss though i would imagine it would be a rare case if it did  not based on skepticism but the reality of how hard it is for men to regrow hair  but even if you try it and it doesnt work for you toji backs up their product as i note below  now that i have my review of toji the product out of the way id like to provide some positive feedback on tojis customer service which i feel is worthy of stars  i am happy to point out that toji backedup their guarantee and made the initiative to contact me and refund me for the three bottles without hesitation  this is commendable no doubt  in addition theyve relayed to me that they are dropping their marketing verbiage which refers to eclipta alba as the minoxidil alternative  i think this shows good intent on tojis part where that phrase does imply quite a bit and could be misleading  so another commendable action on tojis part  lastly if i can provide any additional information that would give a better review of this product just let me know via the comments  best of luck

this is in my opinion and the opinion of many others the finest film music from all of   john powell seems to have found two niches for himself highly stylized heistspy music and fantastic animation music  ive been aware of powell for a very long time since his zany and superfun collaboration with harry gregsonwilliams for chicken run but really started paying attention to his compositions with the film happy feet  he has many incredible animation scores to his credit but id argue that this is by the far the best  the main themes are ethnically charged with a cross between scottish and nordic influences both in the melodies and instrumentation  theres a lot of raucous action music in this score but where it really shines is in its more intimate moments  my favorite tracks are the dragon book which begins with a deep mens chorus and imbues the scene with dark mystery and awakening awareness and forbidden friendship  the themes develop slowly with vibraphone to begin with but build into a lovely moment of suspended tension in female chorus that is relieved beautifully in a single voice  its really something else  transcendent even  the track romantic flight features a gorgeous and floating violin solo as well  the cd has many highlights but those are the best  preview them if you can youll be sold that this is some of the best music written for film in the last few years

i alternate between my dds office and a specialist every three months advised me not to turn it above halfway  i was very pleased to be able to use this in place of flossing  however when i went to the specialists office yesterday for a cleaning the oral hygienist there advised me that this will not replace flossing which is the main reason i purchased this unit  she also found a worsening of the periodontal pocket depth especially around the molars  the only thing i have changed in my oral care routine was to stop flossing and start using this unit  so i must conclude that the worsening is to to my lack of flossing  i have resumed flossing and will continue to use this in conjunction with brushing flossing and antibacterial mouthwash and see if subsequent visits reveal improved results  the tip on the wand can be easily removed by pressing the little blue button near the base of the tip  actually it is a little too easy to accidentally depress  once i got used to this fact i found myself holding the wand farther down to avoid this  not a show stopper just a minor thing to take into account when you grip the wand  the reservoir lid has a place to store the extra tips and awkward to handle and it can easily fall into the reservoir while you are trying to put it on  i realize it is probably impossible to make a perfect design but imho they would have done better to make
